items.summary: Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and reject sitemap or other production work this cycle. The password gate and noindex/nofollow posture make crawl exposure premature and non-measurable. No repository, configuration, credential, infrastructure, schedule, telemetry, or deployment change is authorized. Retain the owner-facing launch-readiness decision; public exposure requires owner disposition plus completed legal, data-rights, accuracy, privacy, security, isolation, attribution, margin, and rollback gates. Existing deployed improvements should continue scheduled measurement without duplicate work.
